>      utilization risk.
>   2. **Prime-Bidder Foreign Exchange (`FX`) Hedging:** Retail evidence is captured in `USD` from `prices.azure.com`
>      unless local-currency billing is contractually established; `{partner_name}` owns `USD -> {currency_code}` FX
>      conversion and multi-year currency hedging.
>   3. **Reseller Margin vs. Fixed-Tier Variance Buffer:** Maintain **reseller commercial margin** and **fixed-tier
>      consumption/rate variance buffer** as separate, auditable parameters in the `.xlsx` workbook — never conflate
>      risk contingency with commercial margin or overwrite raw 1P retail unit rates.

## 3. Step-by-Step Workbook Finalization Guide

Follow these steps in exact sequence inside `commercials/{pursuit_slug}.boq.xlsx` before generating customer-facing
commercial schedules:

1. **Confirm Base Currency & FX Parameters (`Parameters` Sheet):** Verify the `USD -> {currency_code}` spot rate and
   multi-year FX forward/hedge assumption in the dedicated input cells. Keep the `1P_Retail_USD` columns untouched so
   `SHA-256` audit traceability to `prices.azure.com` remains intact.
2. **Set Reseller Margin Separately from Fixed-Tier Variance Buffer:**
   - Enter commercial **Reseller Margin / Markup (%)** in `{margin_cell_ref}` (reflecting partner commercial return,
     billing administration, and CSP/EA program terms).
   - Enter **Unreserved PAYG & Consumption Variance Buffer (%)** in `{buffer_cell_ref}` (separate technical/commercial
     contingency covering unreserved PAYG rate changes, storage transaction spikes, and egress variance when bidding a
     fixed monthly fee).
3. **Replace Every `"QUOTE REQUIRED"` Sentinel (`Partner_Quotes` Sheet):** Obtain binding written quotes for all items
   in `P1`–`{Pn}` (assessment/migration labor, 24x7 managed DR/operations, BYOL/ISV subscriptions, and telco circuits)
   and replace each `"QUOTE REQUIRED"` cell with the quoted figure and vendor quote reference ID.
4. **Execute the Submission Blocker Gate:**
   - Confirm the workbook `Submission_Gate_Status` cell evaluates to `READY` (`0` remaining `"QUOTE REQUIRED"` strings
     across active bid tabs and `0` `#REF!`, `#NAME?`, `#VALUE!`, or `#N/A` formula errors).
   - If copying figures into a customer-mandated `.xlsx` tender template, run `xlsx_ast_cache.py` with
     `--compare-template` to confirm zero stripped Data Validations, defined names, protection rules, or
     `> 255`-character headers/footers.

## 6. Mandatory Statement-of-Work Risk Boundaries

Embed these explicit contractual boundaries in `{partner_name}`'s commercial proposal and Statement of Work (`SoW`):

1. **Source Remediation & Lifecycle Prerequisite:** End-of-support operating systems, database engines, and Kubernetes
   versions identified in `{Q1}`–`{Qn}` require customer-approved upgrade or paid extended-support remediation before
   production SLA activation.
2. **Timed Failover / Performance Acceptance Gate:** Recovery time (`{rto_target}`) and recovery point
   (`{rpo_target}`) commitments are architecture-capable designs (`[drill unproven]` at bid stage) contingent on
   non-disruptive pilot seeding, carrier bandwidth verification, and customer application sign-off during an isolated
   acceptance drill.
3. **Single-Authoritative-Writer Fencing:** Planned and unplanned cutovers require execution of the agreed DNS/network
   fencing runbook so split-brain dual writes cannot occur across primary and recovery sites.
4. **Excluded Source-Cloud / On-Premises Egress & Third-Party Fees:** Incumbent cloud data-egress charges, legacy
   colocation exit fees, and customer-owned BYOL true-ups remain outside the 1P Azure consumption estimate unless
   explicitly priced in `Partner_Quotes`.
5. **Baseline Inventory Change-Order Trigger:** Material growth beyond the baselined `{inventory_baseline_summary}`
   (CPU, RAM, provisioned TiB, IOPS, or daily change-rate churn) triggers a unit-rate adjustment via the live `.xlsx`
   BoQ schedule.
